list.text: 01 SENTINEL / DEVOS ACTIVE A research and operations system for intelligent work. Sentinel / DevOS is a personal AI operating system that unifies research, knowledge management, and automated workflows in a single, focused environment. AI RESEARCH AUTOMATION ARCHITECTURE HOW IT WORKS FIG. 03.01 — SYSTEM FLOW S1 Research and notes come in S2 Organised into one knowledge base S3 Workflows run automa

02 SU A research engine that ties every claim to its source. SU gathers evidence, runs adversarial review, and keeps a traceable link between each conclusion and the material behind it. RESEARCH AI HOW IT WORKS FIG. 03.02 — SYSTEM FLOW S1 Sources collected S2 Evidence extracted S3 Adversarial review S4 Conclusion linked to its sources AUTOMATED STAGE A PERSON DECIDES: CONCLUSION LINKED TO ITS SOUR

03 CLINICFLOW Booking and workflow automation for clinics. ClinicFlow moves appointments, reminders and intake through one automated pipeline, with every step visible to staff. AUTOMATION SYSTEMS SECURITY ARCHITECTURE HOW IT WORKS FIG. 03.03 — SYSTEM FLOW S1 Patient books S2 Reminders sent S3 Intake completed S4 Staff see every step AUTOMATED STAGE A PERSON DECIDES: STAFF SEE EVERY STEP ← SU 03 /

04 MAISOG KILAT Strategy research, testing and validation. Maisog Kilat is a research environment for developing strategies and testing them against real data before they are trusted. RESEARCH AI SYSTEMS ARCHITECTURE HOW IT WORKS FIG. 03.04 — SYSTEM FLOW S1 Strategy proposed S2 Tested on real data S3 Results measured S4 Trusted or rejected AUTOMATED STAGE A PERSON DECIDES: TRUSTED OR REJECTED ← Cl

05 MAISOG GUILD An opportunity and quest platform. Maisog Guild turns opportunities into structured quests that people can discover, take on and complete. systems.text: 01 / SYSTEMS IDEAS · SYSTEMS · PROJECTS · A MORE INTELLIGENT WORLD Six disciplines, one working system. Select a discipline to see what it connects to and which lab projects use it. 01 AI 02 AUTOMAT

list.text: 01 CLINICFLOW AI-assisted booking and workflow automation for dental clinics. ClinicFlow is an AI-assisted clinic automation prototype for handling patient conversations, appointment intake, scheduling, reminders and staff handoff through one structured workflow. AI AUTOMATION SYSTEMS SECURITY HOW IT WORKS FIG. 03.01 — SYSTEM FLOW S1 Patient starts a conversation S2 Request is structured and valid

02 ETERNAL EGGS A conversational ordering system built around real customer orders. Eternal Eggs is a conversational ordering system in development that turns customer messages into structured orders with quantity checks, totals, delivery details and duplicate protection. AI AUTOMATION SYSTEMS HOW IT WORKS FIG. 03.02 — SYSTEM FLOW S1 Customer sends an order S2 Order details are extracted and check

03 SENTINEL / DEVOS ACTIVE A governed system for coordinating human and AI software development. Sentinel / DevOS is the active governance system used inside MaisogLabs to coordinate AI-assisted software work, including scope, implementation, evidence and human review. AI RESEARCH AUTOMATION ARCHITECTURE SECURITY HOW IT WORKS FIG. 03.03 — SYSTEM FLOW S1 Work begins from an explicit decision S2 Sco

04 SU An evidence-first research engine built to challenge its own conclusions. SU is an experimental evidence-first research system for gathering sources, tracing claims, searching for contradictions and reviewing conclusions against the evidence behind them. RESEARCH AI ARCHITECTURE HOW IT WORKS FIG. 03.04 — SYSTEM FLOW S1 Sources are collected S2 Claims and evidence are mapped S3 Contradictions

05 MAISOG KILAT Algorithmic trading research with deterministic testing and risk controls. Maisog Kilat is a research environment for developing and backtesting trading strategies against market data under explicit risk controls. It is not presented as a proven trading product. RESEARCH AI SYSTEMS ARCHITECTURE HOW IT WORKS FIG. 03.05 — SYSTEM FLOW S1 A strategy hypothesis is defined S2 It is teste
